name: PdxFormSection
description:
Groups related fields of a form under a labelled heading, and can scope validation to its own
fields.

members.name: label
members.description: Display label for the section header.

members.name: fields
members.description: Comma-separated field names that belong to this section.

members.name: active
members.description: Whether the section is currently active/visible.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Display label for the section header.

attributes.name: fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated field names that belong to this section.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether the section is currently active/visible.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssStates.name: active
cssStates.description: `active` (the default): the section is shown; a section that is not active is hidden.

cssStates.name: invalid
cssStates.description: The last `validateSection()` found an error in one of its fields.
